title: Finite locally free dual conormal on its rank stratum
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], with Y Noetherian. Suppose every z∈Z has an affine neighbourhood U of i(z) on which the kernel ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let C be the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] of that kernel ideal to Z. Let r:Z→ℕ be locally constant and equal at each z to the finrank of the module stalk [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] of C. For each n∈ℕ the restriction of Hom(C,O_Z) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] to the open rank-n stratum [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex] is finite locally free of rank n [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].

source.place: Tag 0BR0 (lemma-regular-immersion), normal sheaf and locally constant rank; Tag 0BQZ (lemma-regular-immersion-ext), local Koszul calculation

proof.text: Use lem-weil-pbc-affine-conormal-sections to identify the conormal over the inverse image of the chosen affine neighbourhood with the sheaf associated to I/I². Apply lem-sc-koszul-conormal-basis: the Koszul-regular generators give a B-basis indexed by Fin m for B=A/I. Consequently the conormal is finite locally free on this neighbourhood.

On each such trivialization internal Hom into the unit is free with the dual basis, of the same rank m. This is the ordinary dual-basis identification of Hom(B^m,B) with B^m, compatible with restriction of the fixed basis. Localizing the original basis at a point of Z gives a basis of the conormal stalk. Since the stalk ring is nonzero, its finrank is m. The prescribed equality hr therefore forces m=n at every point in the rank-n stratum. Restrict the cover to that stratum and use these dual frames as locally free generators data with n elements. Empty rank strata and n=0 satisfy the same construction.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BQZ and 0BR0, expanded affine conormal and dual-basis argument

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_dual_conormal_rank_stratum {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n).ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
        (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank n
